Other exceptions to the 10% additional tax include payments to a beneficiary after the owner's death, a series of substantially equal periodic payments (72(t)), qualified disaster recovery distributions and distributions to domestic abuse victims. The 10% tax applies only to the taxable part of a withdrawal.
